The test image clearly shows **green stems** with **brown/mature dried pods** — the defining characteristic of Green Stem Disorder, where the stem fails to senesce normally while pods mature and dry. This matches the Green_stem_disorder reference images almost exactly (same setting, same plant stage, green stems with dried pods).

Diaporthe shows dark stem lesions/cankers which is different. Phomopsis shows pod spotting patterns, also different.
